page.title: Tessel Transcode Server
page.sub: Reads your SMB share, transcodes only what the TV can't play, streams it back.
status.title: Status
smb.title: SMB Share
adopt.toggle: Let a paired TV copy these settings
adopt.explain: Saves typing the share, username and password again on a TV remote — the TV pulls them from here when it pairs. They're only on offer for ten minutes after this box starts, after you save the share, or after you press the button below; outside that window the password isn't handed out at all. Turn the switch off to never hand it out.
pb.title: Playback
pb.explain: Playback settings live on the TV, under {0} — that's where you are when you notice the sound is wrong. They're shown here so you can see what the box is doing.
pb.relayToggle: Allow the TV to send USB / internal files
pb.relayExplain: A paired TV turns this on for itself when you enable {0} there. Switch it off here to revoke that — the box will stop accepting files from the TV and go back to reading only from the share.
tv.relayOption: Play USB files through the server
pair.title: Pair with TV
pair.lan: Nothing to do here. On the TV, open {0} — it sweeps your LAN, finds this box, pairs, and copies the share settings above.
tv.findMenu: Settings → Transcode server → Find server on my network
pair.manual: If the scan comes up empty (guest Wi-Fi, VLANs, a subnet wider than /22), pick {0} on the TV and type {1}.
pair.codeExplain: The original method, kept for networks where the TV can't reach this box directly. It relays through ntfy.sh, so it needs internet on both ends. On the TV: {0}, then type the code it shows here {1} pressing Pair on the TV.
tv.codeMenu: Settings → Transcode server → Pair with a code
testcard.title: Test transcoding
testcard.explain: Open this in VLC on a laptop to confirm a file plays (replace the path):
adopt.off: switched off — the TV will never get these
adopt.closed: closed — a TV pairing now must be given the share by hand
adopt.reopenFailed: Could not reopen the pairing window.
adopt.reopened: Pairing window open — pair the TV now.
pair.last: Last paired with code {0} · {1} — the TV should still be paired; only re-pair if you reinstall the app on it.
pair.needCode: Enter the code shown on the TV.
pair.sent: Sent {0} to the TV. Press “Pair” on the TV to finish.
pb.relaySaved: Saved. The TV may now send files from its USB drive.
pb.relayRevoked: Saved. The box will only read from the share again.
